# Planned final parameter-name policy validation

**Status: prepared, unexecuted.** Root runs the fixed driver after completed
latest/MSRV Rust validation, the after capture, current metadata review and
final Reference/Book barrier:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/frontend_v030/common-parameter-declaration-design/policy-validation/driver.py attempt-01
```

This derives the [preceding policy driver](../../common-pattern-design/policy-validation/driver-v2.py)
and keeps the same **13 authored commands**: pinned mdBook 0.5.4 version/build,
rendered HTML/print-link checking, book/authoring/source-edition/docs integrity
and regression checks, constitutional continuity against
`faa5cfb5e7ea1cf3b39a43b80f7f2345e89197c2`, and active verification-inventory
and production-coverage guards. The four unchanged policy suites contain
12/7/11/36 tests, totalling 66. The driver records actual counts and rejects a
missing/different suite; no successful new run is inferred from those counts.

The metadata binding uses the actual **parameter-name three-file review**,
including inventory exit 1 before refresh and exit 0 after, and coverage exit
0 before and after. It pins the retained compressed after copies and checks
their exact equality with active metadata. All 253 reviewed source identities
must still match. Parsed route/proof criteria, public surfaces, constructors
and statuses keep their existing limits. The previous pattern unit's source
checkpoint is not used as a current-source identity map.

The old 17 inventory and 14 coverage mutation results remain separate historical
records and are **not rerun or counted as fresh policy tests**. Raw results are
retained; their guard/test scripts are also compared with the later prior
policy identity map. The historical mutation packet did not freeze script
bytes at its own execution, so this does not manufacture a complete historical
script/fixture/build closure. Recorded commands are always data, never executed.

At execution, the driver requires the terminal 40-check after capture with
exact raw outputs/status/native argv and all 44 native calls unchanged. It
guards the original first map, complete 200-file before packet, additional
before report and full after packet. Latest and MSRV must each have terminal
successful eight-stage results on the same three changed production bytes.
Those are separate root-run checks, not commands or tests performed here.

Final input identities are collected **at root execution**, after Reference,
changelog and the Book are frozen. They include current production Rust,
kernel source, stdlib, Cargo/constitutional records, policy scripts, active
metadata, complete selected authoring/validation packets and current docs.
This declared map is incomplete for general fixture/runtime/proof/build
closure. Current native, mdBook and prebuilt CLI bytes are observed separately
and must remain unchanged; no executable/Git attestation follows.

Each attempt uses a new directory and retains genuine stdout/stderr, child
exits, launch errors and timeouts. Only the driver's small owned temporary
mdBook output is removed after its generated-file hashes and real check output
are saved. Independent Python checks use at most two workers. No Cargo, CLI,
native-checker or Lean command is invoked by this policy driver.

This unit shares only parameter spelling claims and iterative original runtime
name traversal. Type/kind/premise/access/value/body policies remain staged.
Passing these checks neither finishes a common checker or canonical std/QFT
API, proves source preservation, discharges QS/PR/RS/EXACT, closes an Issue,
completes full CI nor approves a release. Both admitted ordinary QLV1 guarantees
and all broader pending obligations retain their current scopes and status.
